subject: C
topic: Current Events — Local, National & International (J&K focus)

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: Jammu & Kashmir was reorganized into two Union Territories on which date?
questions.explanation: J&K was reorganized into two UTs (J&K with legislature and Ladakh without legislature) on 31 October 2019, when the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019 came into effect. 5 August 2019 is when the Reorganisation Bill was passed in Parliament. 26 January 2020 and 15 August 2019 are incorrect dates.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019:

(i) It bifurcated the former state into two Union Territories.
(ii) J&K UT has a legislative assembly while Ladakh UT does not.
(iii) The Act also abrogated Article 370 of the Constitution.
(iv) Both UTs are headed by a Chief Minister with full statehood powers.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — one state became two UTs. (ii) is correct — J&K UT has an elected legislature; Ladakh doesn't. (iii) is correct — Article 370 was effectively abrogated on 5 August 2019 through a Presidential Order and the Act. (iv) is wrong — as UTs, they are headed by Lt. Governors; the J&K UT has a CM but with limited powers compared to a full state.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The first Lieutenant Governor of the Union Territory of J&K was:
questions.explanation: Girish Chandra Murmu was the first LG of J&K UT (31 October 2019). Satya Pal Malik was the last Governor of the erstwhile state. Manoj Sinha is a subsequent LG who took charge in August 2020. R.K. Mathur was the first LG of Ladakh UT.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL) project is considered strategically important for J&K.
Reason (R): The rail link will provide all-weather connectivity between the Kashmir Valley and the rest of India, reducing dependence on road transport that is often disrupted by weather and landslides.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — USBRL is a mega strategic project. (R) is correct — the railway will provide reliable year-round connectivity unlike the Jammu-Srinagar Highway which frequently closes due to snow, landslides, and rain. (R) directly explains why the project is strategically important.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following recent infrastructure projects in J&K with their descriptions:

Column I:
(a) Chenani-Nashri Tunnel
(b) Zoji La Tunnel (under construction)
(c) Chenab Railway Bridge
(d) Atal Tunnel (Rohtang)

Column II:
(i) World's highest railway bridge on USBRL project
(ii) India's longest road tunnel connecting Jammu to Srinagar corridor
(iii) Strategic tunnel connecting Srinagar to Leh/Ladakh
(iv) Highway tunnel in Himachal connecting Manali to Lahaul-Spiti

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Chenani-Nashri (9.2 km) is India's longest road tunnel on NH-44 (ii). Zoji La Tunnel will connect Srinagar to Leh, providing all-weather access to Ladakh (iii). Chenab Bridge is the world's highest railway bridge (i). Atal Tunnel is in Himachal Pradesh connecting Manali to Lahaul-Spiti (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'New Central Sector Scheme for Industrial Development of J&K' was announced in 2021 with an outlay of approximately:
questions.explanation: The scheme was approved with ₹28,400 crore for the period 2021-2037 to attract investment, create employment, and boost manufacturing in J&K. ₹12,000 and ₹19,500 crore underestimate. ₹45,000 crore overestimates.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about elections in J&K after reorganisation:

(i) The first J&K UT Legislative Assembly elections were conducted after reorganisation.
(ii) District Development Council (DDC) elections were held in 2020 — the first grassroots elections post-reorganisation.
(iii) The Delimitation Commission redrew constituency boundaries for J&K.
(iv) J&K now has more Assembly seats in Jammu division after delimitation.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (ii) is correct — DDC elections in Nov-Dec 2020 were the first grassroots democratic exercise post-reorganisation. (iii) is correct — the Delimitation Commission (headed by Justice Ranjana Desai) redrew boundaries in 2022. (iv) is correct — Jammu division got more seats (43 vs 47 in Kashmir, from earlier 37 vs 46). (i) is partially misleading in this context — while Assembly elections have been announced/conducted subsequently, the phrasing suggests they were the first post-reorganisation elections, when DDC elections actually came first.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Amarnath Yatra shrine is located in which district of J&K?
questions.explanation: The Amarnath Cave shrine is located in the Pahalgam area of Anantnag district. The traditional route starts from Pahalgam (Anantnag). The shorter Baltal route is via Ganderbal but the cave itself is in Anantnag district. Srinagar and Kulgam are not correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Government of India has been promoting J&K as a major investment destination.
Reason (R): After the removal of Article 370, land purchase and investment by people from outside J&K became possible, opening up economic opportunities.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — multiple investor summits and industrial schemes have been launched. (R) is correct — Article 370 previously restricted outsiders' ability to buy property and invest; its removal opened J&K to national and international investment. (R) explains (A) because the removal of legal barriers is the direct reason enabling the investment promotion drive.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following centrally sponsored schemes have been extended to J&K after reorganisation?

(i) Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
(ii) Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
(iii) Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
(iv) All central laws and schemes now apply to J&K

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: After reorganisation, all central schemes and laws were extended to J&K. PMAY (i) provides housing. Ayushman Bharat (ii) provides health insurance. PM-KISAN (iii) provides income support to farmers. (iv) is correct as a general statement — as a UT, all central legislation applies directly.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Srinagar Smart City project aims to:
options: Demolish all old buildings in Srinagar
Develop Srinagar as a modern, sustainable city with improved infrastructure, IT connectivity, and public services
Relocate all residents to new housing complexes
Convert Srinagar into an industrial manufacturing hub only
questions.correctAnswer: Develop Srinagar as a modern, sustainable city with improved infrastructure, IT connectivity, and public services
questions.explanation: Smart City projects focus on sustainable urban development — improved roads, IT infrastructure, waste management, public transport, and e-governance. It doesn't demolish heritage structures. It doesn't relocate residents. It's not exclusively about industrial manufacturing.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the 'Back to Village' programme in J&K:

(i) It is a government outreach programme to connect administration with rural people.
(ii) Officers visit villages to address grievances and ensure delivery of government schemes.
(iii) It aims to ensure last-mile delivery of development benefits.
(iv) It was launched only for urban areas.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — B2V bridges the gap between government and rural citizens. (ii) is correct — officers visit panchayats to resolve issues on the spot. (iii) is correct — ensuring schemes reach the intended beneficiaries. (iv) is wrong — it is specifically for VILLAGES (rural areas), as the name 'Back to Village' indicates.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The GI (Geographical Indication) tag for 'Kashmir Saffron' was obtained in which year?
questions.explanation: Kashmir Saffron received its GI tag in 2020, recognising its unique quality and origin from the Karewa lands of Pampore. 2018 is when Kashmir Pashmina got its GI. 2022 and 2024 are incorrect.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following recent developments in J&K with their significance:

Column I:
(a) DDC Elections (2020)
(b) Delimitation Commission Report (2022)
(c) G20 Tourism Working Group Meeting (2023)
(d) Extension of 73rd/74th Amendments to J&K

Column II:
(i) International event showcasing J&K's tourism potential
(ii) First democratic elections at grassroots after reorganisation
(iii) Redrawing of Assembly constituency boundaries
(iv) Panchayati Raj and urban local body reforms applied to J&K

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: DDC elections were the first grassroots elections post-reorganisation (ii). Delimitation redrew constituency boundaries (iii). G20 Tourism Working Group meeting in Srinagar showcased J&K internationally (i). Extension of 73rd/74th Amendments brings Panchayati Raj/Municipal reforms (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): Tourism in J&K has seen a significant revival in recent years with record tourist arrivals.
Reason (R): Improved security situation, better infrastructure, and active promotion by the government have attracted both domestic and international tourists.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — J&K tourism has bounced back strongly with record numbers in recent years. (R) is correct — improved security, new infrastructure (tunnels, roads), and government campaigns (Incredible India, film tourism) are key factors. (R) explains (A) by identifying the specific reasons driving the tourism revival.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Delimitation Commission for J&K increased the total number of Assembly seats to:
questions.explanation: The Delimitation Commission increased J&K's Assembly seats from 83 (previously 87 including PoK seats) to 90 seats (43 in Jammu + 47 in Kashmir), plus 24 reserved for PoK areas. 83 was the previous effective strength. 87 included PoK seats in the old arrangement. 95 is incorrect.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Jal Jeevan Mission in J&K:

(i) It aims to provide functional household tap connections to every rural household.
(ii) J&K has made significant progress in providing piped water supply.
(iii) The mission is funded entirely by individual households.
(iv) It addresses the issue of water scarcity and quality in rural areas.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal) targets 100% tap connections. (ii) is correct — J&K has reported major progress in coverage. (iv) is correct — providing clean piped water addresses quality and scarcity issues. (iii) is wrong — the mission is centrally and state-funded (government bears the cost), not funded by individual households.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Holistic Agriculture Development Programme' (HADP) launched for J&K focuses on:
options: Comprehensive agricultural transformation including high-density plantations, cold chains, and market linkages
Importing food grains from other states
questions.correctAnswer: Comprehensive agricultural transformation including high-density plantations, cold chains, and market linkages
questions.explanation: HADP takes a holistic approach covering high-density fruit orchards, saffron revival, cold storage infrastructure, market access, and diversification. It's not limited to apples alone. It doesn't replace agriculture. It aims to strengthen local production, not increase dependence on imports.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the IIT Jammu:

(i) IIT Jammu was established as part of the expansion of IITs across India.
(ii) It is located in the Jagti area of Jammu.
(iii) It offers B.Tech, M.Tech, and PhD programmes.
(iv) IIT Jammu is the only technical institution in J&K.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — IIT Jammu (established 2016) is one of the newer IITs. (ii) is correct — its permanent campus is at Jagti. (iii) is correct — it offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes. (iv) is wrong — J&K also has NIT Srinagar, IUST Awantipora, and other technical institutions.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Government has been actively promoting film shooting in J&K through a dedicated Film Policy.
Reason (R): Film tourism attracts visitors to shooting locations, generates employment, and provides global publicity for J&K's natural beauty.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — J&K has introduced a Film Policy with incentives and single-window clearance. (R) is correct — Bollywood/film tourism drives visitor interest and economic activity. (R) explains (A) because the economic and publicity benefits described in (R) are exactly why the government is promoting film shooting.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Ayushman Bharat — SEHAT' scheme in J&K provides:
options: Health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year
questions.correctAnswer: Health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year
questions.explanation: Ayushman Bharat-SEHAT (Social Endeavour for Health and Telemedicine) provides ₹5 lakh health insurance per family, covering all residents of J&K. Free education is under RTE. Free housing is under PMAY. Employment guarantee is under MGNREGA.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are key features of the J&K Official Languages Act, 2020?

(i) Urdu, Hindi, English, Kashmiri, and Dogri are official languages.
(ii) It replaced the earlier state law that had only Urdu as official language.
(iii) It promotes linguistic diversity of J&K.
(iv) It bans the use of all local languages in government offices.

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — five languages are now official. (ii) is correct — previously only Urdu was the official language. (iii) is correct — recognising multiple languages respects J&K's diversity. (iv) is wrong — the Act promotes local languages; it does NOT ban them.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Mumkin' scheme launched in J&K provides:
options: Commercial vehicles to educated youth for livelihood in transport sector
questions.correctAnswer: Commercial vehicles to educated youth for livelihood in transport sector
questions.explanation: 'Mumkin' provides light commercial vehicles (LCVs) to educated unemployed youth at subsidised rates for self-employment in the transport sector. It's not about smartphones. It's not pension. It's not scholarships.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Chenab Bridge (Anji Khad Bridge) on the USBRL project:

(i) It is the world's highest railway bridge.
(ii) It is taller than the Eiffel Tower.
(iii) It is located in the Reasi district of J&K.
(iv) The bridge is made entirely of wood and bamboo.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — at 359 m above the riverbed, it is the world's highest railway bridge. (ii) is correct — the Eiffel Tower is 330 m; the bridge is higher. (iii) is correct — it's in Reasi district on the Chenab river. (iv) is wrong — it's a steel arch bridge, not wood and bamboo.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following J&K-specific schemes with their focus areas:

Column I:
(a) Mumkin
(b) HIMAYAT
(c) Tejaswini
(d) UMEED

Column II:
(i) Skill training and placement for J&K youth
(ii) Self-employment through livelihood missions for women
(iii) Financial assistance and mentoring for young women entrepreneurs
(iv) Providing commercial vehicles to youth for transport business

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Mumkin provides commercial vehicles to youth (iv). HIMAYAT is a skill training and placement programme (i). Tejaswini supports young women entrepreneurs with loans and mentoring (iii). UMEED is a livelihood mission empowering women through self-help groups (ii).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Government has been working to make J&K a hub for IT and IT-enabled services.
Reason (R): Improved internet connectivity (including 4G/5G restoration), IT parks, and incentives for tech companies are being developed to create knowledge-economy jobs for educated youth.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — IT development is a stated priority. (R) is correct — internet restoration, IT infrastructure, and incentives are concrete steps. (R) explains (A) because these specific interventions (connectivity + infrastructure + incentives) are the means by which the IT hub goal is being pursued.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the recent expansion of air connectivity in J&K:

(i) New flights under the UDAN (Regional Connectivity) scheme have been started.
(ii) Direct flights from Srinagar to major Indian cities have increased.
(iii) Jammu airport has undergone expansion and modernisation.
(iv) Air travel in J&K has been permanently banned.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — UDAN flights connect smaller J&K towns. (ii) is correct — direct flights to cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru have increased. (iii) is correct — Jammu airport has been expanded. (iv) is wrong — air travel is thriving in J&K, not banned.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'PM Development Package' (PMDP) for J&K, announced in 2015, focused on:
options: Comprehensive development including roads, hospitals, universities, and employment
questions.correctAnswer: Comprehensive development including roads, hospitals, universities, and employment
questions.explanation: PMDP included ₹80,000+ crore for infrastructure (AIIMS Jammu, IIT Jammu, IIM Jammu, highways, railways, power projects). It's not military-only. It's not limited to tourism. It's not exclusively agricultural.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the G20 Tourism Working Group meeting held in Srinagar (2023):

(i) It was the first major international event in Kashmir after reorganisation.
(ii) It showcased J&K's tourism potential to global delegates.
(iii) It was attended by representatives from G20 member nations.
(iv) It was held in Leh, not Srinagar.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — a significant diplomatic milestone for J&K. (ii) is correct — delegates experienced Kashmir's beauty firsthand. (iii) is correct — G20 member nations' representatives attended. (iv) is wrong — the meeting was held in SRINAGAR, not Leh.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: The __________ Commission, headed by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, redrew J&K's Assembly constituency boundaries in 2022.
questions.explanation: The Delimitation Commission redrew constituency boundaries (delimitation = fixing boundaries). The Election Commission conducts elections. The Planning Commission (now NITI Aayog) dealt with economic planning. The Finance Commission allocates revenue between Centre and states.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following educational institutions were established in J&K under the PM Development Package?

(i) AIIMS Jammu
(ii) IIT Jammu
(iii) IIM Jammu
(iv) All India Radio Srinagar

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: (i) AIIMS Jammu (at Vijaypur, Samba) was announced under PMDP — correct. (ii) IIT Jammu was established as part of new IIT expansion/PMDP — correct. (iii) IIM Jammu was established under PMDP — correct. (iv) All India Radio Srinagar has existed since much before PMDP — it's not a PMDP institution.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The restoration of 4G mobile internet in J&K was seen as a significant step.
Reason (R): Internet connectivity is essential for education, business, e-governance, and digital payments, and its restriction had adversely affected these sectors.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — 4G restoration (February 2021 onwards) was widely welcomed. (R) is correct — internet is critical for modern life and its restriction had impacted students, businesses, and governance. (R) explains (A) because the importance of internet for these essential activities is precisely why its restoration was considered significant.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Aspirational District Programme' in J&K covers which districts?
options: Identified backward districts like Kupwara, Baramulla, Anantnag, etc.
All 20 districts equally without any prioritisation
questions.correctAnswer: Identified backward districts like Kupwara, Baramulla, Anantnag, etc.
questions.explanation: The Aspirational District Programme (NITI Aayog initiative) targets specific underdeveloped districts to rapidly improve key indicators in health, education, agriculture, and infrastructure. It doesn't cover only the two main cities. It's not about Ladakh (separate UT). It's not equally for all — it specifically targets backward districts.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Swachh Bharat Mission in J&K:

(i) It aims to make J&K open-defecation free (ODF).
(ii) Individual household toilets have been constructed under the scheme.
(iii) Several districts have been declared ODF.
(iv) The mission discourages construction of toilets.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — ODF target is a core goal. (ii) is correct — lakhs of individual toilets built. (iii) is correct — many J&K districts have achieved ODF status. (iv) is wrong — the mission actively PROMOTES and funds toilet construction, not discourages it.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following national events with their connection to J&K:

Column I:
(a) Article 370 abrogation
(b) Mann Ki Baat mentions J&K
(c) Yoga Day celebrations at Dal Lake
(d) Republic Day Parade — J&K tableau

Column II:
(i) Showcasing J&K's culture and development on national stage
(ii) Removal of special status provisions
(iii) Prime Minister highlighting J&K's achievements
(iv) Promoting wellness tourism and India's soft power

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Article 370 abrogation removed special status (ii). Mann Ki Baat references highlight J&K achievements (iii). Yoga Day at Dal Lake promotes wellness tourism (iv). J&K's Republic Day tableau showcases its culture nationally (i).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana) in J&K:

(i) It provides housing to eligible homeless/inadequately housed families.
(ii) Both urban and rural components are being implemented.
(iii) Financial assistance is provided for construction/upgradation of houses.
(iv) Only families earning above ₹25 lakh per year are eligible.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) is correct — targets homeless and those in kutcha houses. (ii) is correct — PMAY-Urban and PMAY-Gramin both operate. (iii) is correct — subsidy/assistance for construction. (iv) is wrong — it targets economically weaker sections (EWS) and low/middle income groups, NOT high-income families earning ₹25 lakh+.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: The __________ summit held in Srinagar in 2024 aimed to attract private investment to J&K.
questions.explanation: J&K has hosted Investors' Summits to attract private sector investment. G7 is a meeting of 7 advanced economies (not held in Srinagar). SAARC is a South Asian regional group. Military summits don't aim at private investment.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The J&K administration has been digitising land records and implementing e-governance.
Reason (R): Digital land records reduce disputes, prevent encroachment, and make property transactions transparent and efficient.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) is correct — land digitisation and e-governance are ongoing. (R) is correct — digital records bring transparency, reduce litigation, and speed up services. (R) explains (A) because these benefits are the direct motivation for undertaking the digitisation effort.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
The following data shows tourist arrivals (in lakhs) to J&K over recent years:

| Year | Tourist Arrivals (lakhs) |
|------|---------------------------|
| 2019 | 145 |
| 2020 | 35 |
| 2021 | 112 |
| 2022 | 189 |
| 2023 | 210 |

Which year saw the sharpest decline compared to the previous year, and what was the primary reason?
questions.explanation: 2020 saw the sharpest decline (145 → 35 lakhs, a ~76% drop) primarily due to the COVID-19 pandemic and nationwide lockdowns that halted travel. 2021 actually recovered significantly. 2022 and 2023 showed growth, not decline.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
The following data shows the progress of different schemes in J&K (as percentage of target achieved):

| Scheme | Target Coverage | Achieved |
|--------|-----------------|----------|
| Jal Jeevan Mission | 100% HH | 78% |
| PM Awas Yojana | 2 lakh houses | 65% |
| Ayushman Bharat | Universal | 92% |
| Swachh Bharat (ODF) | All districts | 85% |

Which scheme has the highest achievement percentage?
questions.explanation: Ayushman Bharat has the highest achievement at 92%. Swachh Bharat is at 85% (second). Jal Jeevan Mission is at 78% (third). PM Awas Yojana is at 65% (lowest). This shows healthcare coverage has progressed fastest among these schemes.
